(def assoc!
 "When applied to a transient map, adds mapping of key(s) to
  val(s). When applied to a transient vector, sets the val at index.
  Note - index must be <= (count vector). Returns coll."
 (fn
 ([tcoll key val]
    (let [associated (suss.bootstrap/transient-map-assoc tcoll key val)]
      (if (suss.bootstrap/undefined? associated) (-assoc! tcoll key val) associated)))
  ([tcoll key val & kvs]
    (let [ntcoll (-assoc! tcoll key val)]
      (if kvs
        (recur ntcoll (first kvs) (second kvs) (nnext kvs))
        ntcoll)))))
